title: Sixteen Thousand Left Kabul: The One Rider Who Returned
summary: Recounts the destruction, within a single week in the dead of winter, of the sixteen-thousand-strong British column that set out from Kabul for Jalalabad on the sixth of January, eighteen forty-two, and how only one wounded surgeon reached the fortress gate on the thirteenth of January. The episode ranges from the invasion that placed Shah Shuja on the throne to the safe-passage agreement made with Mohammad Akbar Khan, from the slaughter in the Khurd Kabul and Jagdalak passes to the last square on the hill at Gandamak, and on to the Army
